text:
Ava: Quick heads up — scheduling a small base-image prune + rebuild next Wed 02:00 UTC. Need RBAC sign-off (who can bind keystore roles) and a short KMS key rotation window. Can we sync?
Sana: @Ava OK. Which keystore? KMS key alias or project?
Ava: It's the internal image-signing key (alias /redwood/image-signer-prod). Rotation planned after canary passes.
Miguel: For runtime: we should avoid evicting cached layers during peak hours. Plan: canary in staging, then staggered prod rollouts by region.
Jon: Incident playbook notes — if a signed image fails startup healthchecks, we should have fallback to previous signed digest AND a fast emergency rollback role for SREs. Also need audit entries for any manual rollback.
Ava: Agreed. We also need RBAC granularity so only the signer-service and release-engineer group can sign images. No wide rolebindings.
Sana: Proposal:
```yaml
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: image-signing-access
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get", "update"]
```
And bind only to `group:release-engineers` + `serviceAccount:signer@infra`.
Miguel: Runtime-side: add a preflight that checks KV cache integrity and image attestation before promoting canary. Failing preflight → abort rollout.
audit-bot: Audit config reminder — image-sign operations will be logged to `projects/redwood/logs/image-sign-audit` and retained 180d. Alert on manual signer key usage outside release windows.
Jon: One more: Add quick script for emergency rollback with minimal privileges. Example:
```bash
# emergency rollback
kubectl set image deployment/api api=image@sha256:<prev-digest> --record
```
Ava: Action items:
- Sana: prepare RBAC Role + RoleBinding PR (due Mon EOD)
- Miguel: add preflight check + staging canary (due Tue)
- Jon: draft emergency rollback runbook and test (due Tue)
- Audit: confirm log sinks & alert (audit-bot / @audit)
I'll schedule the rebuild once PRs land. Thanks :thumbsup:
